messages.subject: NIMBLE version 1.4.2 released
parts:
We've released version 1.4.2 of nimble.

This is a micro release that primarily addresses some packaging changes requested by CRAN but also improves efficiency of `findSamplersOnNodes`, which is used in finding samplers assigned to node(s).

Please see the NEWS file in the installed package for more details.

- Chris Paciorek for the NIMBLE Development Team
